file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/minimp3/minimp3.h" digest)
if(NOT digest STREQUAL "57e437c5c1f0e8b243885d3929c8973b5e6c778451e0100ab4251d19915cb3ad")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned MO3 minimp3 integrity failure")
endif()
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../media-codecs/stb_vorbis.c" digest)
if(NOT digest STREQUAL "4c7cb2ff1f7011e9d67950446b7eb9ca044f2e464d76bfbb0b84dd2e23e65636")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned MO3 Vorbis integrity failure")
endif()
# Reuse the reviewed constexpr CRC fix, avoiding an independent mutable table.
set(PLAYER2_VORBIS_SOURCE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../media-codecs/stb_vorbis.c")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../media-codecs/prepare_vorbis.cmake")
string(REGEX MATCHALL "stb_vorbis_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+" vorbis_tokens "${vorbis_source}")
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES vorbis_tokens)
set(PLAYER2_MO3_VORBIS_NAMES)
foreach(token IN LISTS vorbis_tokens)
    string(REPLACE "stb_vorbis_" "player2_mo3_vorbis_" renamed "${token}")
    list(APPEND PLAYER2_MO3_VORBIS_NAMES "${token}=${renamed}")
endforeach()
set(PLAYER2_MO3_VORBIS_NAMES "${PLAYER2_MO3_VORBIS_NAMES}" PARENT_SCOPE)
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Player2VorbisImplementation.inc" contents)
string(REPLACE "stb_vorbis_" "player2_mo3_vorbis_" contents "${contents}")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/stb_vorbis")
set(prefixed "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/stb_vorbis/stb_vorbis.c")
set(previous "")
if(EXISTS "${prefixed}")
    file(READ "${prefixed}" previous)
endif()
if(NOT previous STREQUAL contents)
    file(WRITE "${prefixed}" "${contents}")
endif()
add_library(player2_mo3_codecs STATIC Mo3Codecs.cpp)
target_include_directories(player2_mo3_codecs PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_compile_features(player2_mo3_codecs PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
set_target_properties(player2_mo3_codecs PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
